Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIdali
Exhibition name: Arianna ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, before 1965).
Introduced in France by URS (Universal Rose Selection)-Meilland in 1968 as 'Arianna'.
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1969 as 'Arianna'.
rows.Bloom: Carmine-pink, coral-pink shading. Mild fragrance. 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Matte, dark green, leathery foliage.

Height: up to 3' (up to 90cm). Width: up to 3' (up to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
